laws.rule: Possessing 56 g or less of cannabis without authority is still an offence, with a fine of up to EC$500, but it is handled by written notice rather than arrest; smoking or using cannabis in a public place is a fixed-penalty offence. Larger amounts fall under the main Drugs (Prevention of Misuse) Act. Medicinal cannabis is legal only through the Medicinal Cannabis Authority, which can certify visiting patients.
